claims.claim: The Guardian reports an August plan for the Pentagon office of strategic capital to own a third of North American Blue Energy Partners, which Donald Trump called the biggest oil deal in world history, is almost certainly doomed.
claims.episode_span: an August plan for the Pentagon’s office of strategic capital to hold a third of North American Blue Energy Partners
claims.source_title: The truth behind Donald Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
claims.supporting_quote: Then in August, Trump announced that the office of strategic capital at the Pentagon, which he has rapidly transformed , would own a third of the second-biggest private Venezuelan oil firm, North American Blue Energy Partners (Nabep).

claims.claim: The Guardian reports US forces seized Nicolás Maduro in January, held him in the United States, and replaced him with Delcy Rodríguez.
claims.episode_span: US forces seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in January
claims.source_title: The truth behind Donald Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
claims.supporting_quote: US forces stormed Venezuela in January and seized Maduro, who was quickly shuttled to a federal holding facility in the US and replaced by the compliant Delcy Rodríguez.

claims.claim: Experts told The Guardian that Venezuelan law does not allow oil deals longer than 25 years and that the office of strategic capital is not authorized to own company shares.
claims.episode_span: Venezuelan law does not allow oil deals longer than 25 years
claims.source_title: The truth behind Donald Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
claims.supporting_quote: The Venezuelan law governing oil development does not allow for 100-year deals, or anything over 25 years. The office of strategic capital isn’t authorized in US law, experts say, to own shares in companies.

claims.claim: Experts told The Guardian the deal will not bring new capital and will not refill the Strategic Petroleum Reserve soon, and the paper reports the reserve fell to a longtime low after the US invaded Iran.
claims.episode_span: will not refill the Strategic Petroleum Reserve any time soon
claims.source_title: The truth behind Donald Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
claims.supporting_quote: And contrary to Trump’s claims, the Venezuelan oil will not help refill the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve any time in the near future.

claims.claim: The Globe and Mail reports Ottawa denies Canadian spying in Cuba while two sources described intelligence sharing and US satellite equipment in Havana between 2016 and 2018.
claims.episode_span: Ottawa denies Canadians were spying in Cuba, while two unnamed sources
claims.source_title: Canadians were spying for U.S. in Cuba at time of alleged sonic attacks: source
claims.supporting_quote: Two sources tell The Globe that Canada and the United States were working closely together between 2016 and 2018 when diplomats and American intelligence operatives began reporting symptoms including nosebleeds, dizziness, headaches, blurred vision and memory loss.

claims.claim: The Department of Justice confirmed it invoked Section 38 of the Canada Evidence Act in the diplomats’ lawsuit, and a sealing order was issued in April 2025.
claims.episode_span: invoked Section 38 of the Canada Evidence Act
claims.source_title: Canadians were spying for U.S. in Cuba at time of alleged sonic attacks: source
claims.supporting_quote: The Department of Justice confirmed Friday that the government invoked Section 38 of the Canada Evidence Act in the case, a rarely used law that restricts disclosure of matters that could harm national security, national defence or international relations, and is typically triggered in terrorism cases and to protect classified information.

claims.claim: In 2024 Jose Alvarez won Florida House District 46 with 57 percent, Michael Cruz had 39.6 percent and Ivan Rivera 3.4 percent; Alvarez took 66 percent in the August 18 Democratic primary.
claims.episode_span: Alvarez won in 2024 with 57 percent, Cruz 39.6 percent and Rivera 3.4 percent
claims.source_title: Threeway contest for Osceola-Orange state House seat a rematch of 2024
claims.supporting_quote: Alvarez won in 2024 with 57% of the vote, followed by Cruz at 39.6% and Rivera at 3.4%. In the Aug. 18 Democratic primary election he got 66% of the vote in a contest with Robert LeWayne Johnson

claims.claim: State records cited by the Orlando Sentinel put Democrats at 42 percent of District 46 registered voters and Republicans at about 21 percent.

claims.source_title: Threeway contest for Osceola-Orange state House seat a rematch of 2024
claims.supporting_quote: Democrats have 42% of registered voters while Republicans account for about 21%, according to state records.

claims.claim: Amendment 3 would need 60 percent approval to create a $150,000 homestead exemption in 2027 rising to $250,000 in 2028 and to restrict local spending, and Jose Alvarez opposes it.
claims.episode_span: needs 60 percent of voters to create a $150,000 homestead exemption in 2027
claims.source_title: Threeway contest for Osceola-Orange state House seat a rematch of 2024
claims.supporting_quote: If approved by 60% of voters, it would create a $150,000 tax exemption on primary, “homesteaded” homes in 2027, rising to a $250,000 exemption in 2028.

claims.claim: In September Mark Carney embraced Canada becoming the EU’s first associate member, said there is a price for access to the US market, and met Emmanuel Macron in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, while Trump threatened very heavy tariffs if he judged the move unfriendly.

claims.supporting_quote: In September, Carney embraced the prospect of Canada becoming the European Union’s first associate member, not as a step toward full membership, but as a way to reduce Canada’s dependence on any single country without ceding control over its own decisions.
